plan: Create one focused Home Center skill for invisible/functional Fleshpunk metaphor applied to ordinary reality.
Make literal reality the hard anchor: metaphor may name function but may not fabricate anatomy, medicine, physics, implants, or visible evidence.
Integrate the doctrine into Wizard DNS Tango so future Fleshpunk real-world prompts retrieve the rule automatically.
Add a deterministic regression contract and wire it into the Fortress local contract runner.
Read back every changed artifact before claiming durability.
antagonism: Do not turn metaphor into a claim of literal hidden anatomy or supernatural evidence.
Do not require visible biological decoration for Fleshpunk to count; function is the criterion.
Do not let a creative framework override direct medical, anatomical, physical, or photographic observation.
Do not create a parallel Fleshpunk canon; this is a portable interpretation rule.

venicePlanReview.finding: The generalization is corpus-supported and becomes safer and more useful when literal reality is made the non-negotiable ground layer. A focused skill plus Tango routing and regression coverage is the smallest durable implementation.
